blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.store` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a store by its ID. It sends a request to the
[Get Store](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#stores\_getstoresid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the store to retrieve.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the store.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

blocks.html:
This method updates a store. It sends a request to the
[Update Store](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#stores\_poststoresid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the store to update.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the store to update.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the store.

children.name: supported_currencies
children.description: The supported currencies of the store.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency's ISO 3 code.

children.name: is_default
children.description: Whether this currency is the default currency in the store.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description:
Whether prices in this currency are tax inclusive.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/pricing/tax-inclusive-pricing).

children.name: supported_locales
children.description: The supported locales of the store.

children.name: locale_code
children.description: The locale's BCP 47 language tag.

children.name: default_sales_channel_id
children.description: The ID of the default sales channel of the store.

children.name: default_region_id
children.description: The ID of the default region of the store.

children.name: default_location_id
children.description: The ID of the default stock location of the store.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs to store custom data in the store.
